name: TAEWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: TAEWF World Heavyweight Championship of TAEWF: the surviving 1997 Usenet record shows the reigns listed here and nothing of how the belt ended.

name: TAEWF United States Championship
epitaph: Held by "Rude Dog" Alex Reed entering Summer Blast 1996; lost that night to "Flashfire" Dean Ferris. The surviving 1997 Usenet record does not trace the belt's lineage forward from there.
